title: The Basement Cat
lines: Ben was in bed when he heard a sound.
It came from down in the basement.
For a moment he just sat still.
Then he heard a small movement.
Ben got Mom and told her about it.
Mom came down the dark steps with him.
She held the lamp. Ben went in front.
At first they saw just cans and rags.
Then a box in the back tipped over.
Ben got down and had a look.
A small gray cat sat in the box.
"Can it stay?" he asked. "If you feed it."
That was the agreement Ben and Mom made.
Now the cat naps on the warm pavement.

questions.ask: What did Ben hear at the start?
questions.listenFor: A sound from the basement, then a small movement. Lines one to four.

questions.ask: What was the agreement Ben and Mom made?
questions.listenFor: The cat can stay if Ben feeds it. Two people agree - that is what an agreement is.

questions.ask: Would you have gone down the steps? Why?
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Ask what they would have taken with them.
